messages:
Rae: Tiny watercooler poll: whos more passive-aggressiveYAML with a sneaky space, or Semver sending a surprise major? :thinking_face:
Ming: YAML. Its like a stealth ninja. One tab and your service ghosts you. :ghost:
Sofia: Semver is peak drama though. Drops v2.0.0 at 3am and leaves a 500 as a calling card. :skull:
lint-bot: CI: :warning: parse error in config/app.yaml: unexpected indent at line 8
Rae: snippet that caused the chaos:
```yaml
envs:
  - name: MODE
    value: prod
   - name: DEBUG
     value: "false"
```
Ming: that extra space before the second dash is doing crime.
Sofia: office policy proposal: broken YAML -> you bring breakfast. Unexpected major bump -> you bring lunch and an apology card. :coffee:
Rae: I will design the "Semver Apology" card: "Dear team, sorry I changed your runtime. Love, v3.0.0" :laughing:
lint-bot: :white_check_mark: yaml-lint added to CI. First-time offenders will receive a polite reminder.
Ming: also can we make a sticker: "I respect my whitespace"? immediate morale boost.
Sofia: +1. Closing poll: YAML 2, Semver 1. YAML wins by stealth formatting.
